1_is_git_repository.note: contains only the paper PDF and the two released checkpoints; no source code

9_official_sampling: engine/solver.py Trainer.sample_shift: vae_encoder_ecg(ecg)[0] (shape only) -> vae_encoder_ppg(ppg)[0] (cond) -> ema.ema_model.sample_shift(shape, cond) -> vae_decoder_ecg
10_model_load_path: main.py: instantiate_from_config(config['model']) -> Trainer(config, ...) (loads VAE via load_vae_ecg / load_vae_ppg) -> Trainer.load(milestone=10): results_folder/checkpoints/checkpoint-10.pt
11_sample_and_sample_shift: model/latent_rectified_flow/rectified_flow.py: sample(shape, num_steps) = explicit Euler from x ~ N(0, I) at t = 0 to t = 1 (data), timesteps linspace(0,1,S+1)[:-1]; sample_shift(shape, num_steps=10, cond) = sample(...)
12_preprocessing_assumptions: data_process_to_npz/step1.py: per 10-s window, PPG Butterworth band-pass 0.5-8 Hz order 3 (mne, IIR), ECG high-pass 0.5 Hz order 5 + 50 Hz notch, resample_poly to 128 Hz, per-window z-score; step2.py: Savitzky-Golay (PPG 7/2, ECG 11/2) + quality selection. Native rates hard-coded in step1 for the released pipeline: ECG 125 Hz, PPG 25 Hz.
13_expected_ppg_input_shape: [B, 1280, 1] (10 s x 128 Hz; the Trainer unsqueezes [B, 1280])
16_cardioalign_load_sequence: Trainer.__init__: load_vae_ecg -> VAE_Encoder <- encoder_ecg, VAE_Decoder <- decoder_ecg; load_vae_ppg -> VAE_Encoder <- encoder_ecg (sic), VAE_Decoder <- decoder_ppg; all eval(), requires_grad False
sampler_network: EMA model (ema.ema_model), as in the official Trainer.sample_shift
stochasticity_sources: Euler initial noise x ~ N(0, I)
sampling_steps_forwarding: sampling_steps is not forwarded to the model (engine/solver.py:276-280); the model default num_steps=10 runs
provenance_wording: authors' officially released checkpoint; training provenance is strongly implied to be MCMED by the released training configuration but is not explicitly documented for the checkpoint itself
